setup.device: CPU (flex for ours, PyTorch CPU for the reference)
setup.metric: mean L1 distance from a sample to the closest of the eight templates

notes: Parameter count matches the reference exactly (2,439,043), so the architecture is reproduced.
DDPM at 200 steps beats DDIM at 20 in every run, as expected.
At equal steps the reference is faster (407 s against 664 s at 3000) and slightly closer to the templates (0.0397 against 0.047 DDPM).
The 900-step gap narrows by 3000 steps, which points at training dynamics (Burn's default initialisers differ from PyTorch's) rather than a structural difference.
The reference has no test suite; only its training and inference paths can be run.
